setup_logging: setup logging for multiple processes with optional output directory for stdout.log file
get_logger: get a named logger instance or the root logger from the logging hierarchy
log_json_stats: log a dictionary of statistical information as formatted JSON with decimal precision
suppress_print: suppress all print output from the current process by replacing builtins.print
cached_log_stream: open a cached log file stream with automatic atexit cleanup and cloud storage buffering
